title: Move the begin-preparation outcome classification out of the engram_host_adapter.rs dispatch loop
outcome: Move the begin-preparation decision in the Grant branch of the engram_host_adapter.rs dispatch loop into a function in src/engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs. The decision covers preparation_kind, kept_pending, preparation_late, preparation_possibly_sent and kept_pending_unsent. The function returns a small outcome enum, so the loop makes one call. This is a pure code move with behaviour unchanged, under the split rules in CLAUDE.md.
acceptance: Move the begin-preparation outcome classification out of the engram_host_adapter.rs dispatch loop is done
